notes.title: New year update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/525dc09b9bbac8287539576237b81703601ed0d1.png
Sup!
We've got the New Year's update ready!
Some highlights:

 We've made the character skin change system. Now we can make custom outfits!
 A New Year's quest to lift your spirits :)
 Gamepad controls fixed. If you've used a gamepad before, I recommend resetting the control settings to "default"
 You can now slap Vitaly to his juicy ass!
 Stats at the end of each run + global statistics
 Censorship for my Chinese friends!
 Localization of certain things for non-CIS players
 A bit of optimization. Might not be noticeable due to the snowy weather:)
 And various minor tweaks


Love you all in a gay way!
Happy New Year!

notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45133990/b34c8fc98a9a32c2ac4dfd876598fdd1c9e4d74c.png
Sup! What's new:
[olist]
 Fixed UI for ultra-wide monitors
 Added money. For now, it's just for bragging rights and to help new players understand that they need to check EVERY locker :) In the future, we'll let you buy cool stuff with it.
 Optimized cutscenes—at least, I hope so :)
 Added proper Japanese text translation by Hiroshi Ashida
 Added proper Italian text translation by Erixstudio. They're also working on full voice-over
 Fixed the door on the bobblehead stand—it didn't always open before
 A bunch of minor tweaks here and there
[/olist]

Have fun! <3
